import hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(r'C:\Users\stop-\n1-kanji-workspace')
review = root / 'scratch-126' / 'review'
expected = {
 'source-selection-verification-001.json': '0d65e40047536eb850ae57af542206ceeb5c24560b8cfc824220419b329be9a9',
 'coordinator-candidate-verification.json': '0d3be59a7cf6f2f95e9d5b049c608e2e9b0152aca031012a57d2892420c5f8a6',
 'handoff-verification-001.json': '171f22a65f87535186a9fda1fcb7b976c2da7f3fed44b86c00f943c442cdb2fa',
 'prompts/preflight.json': '0478029fbf212de688dad95c53e8ebf8a47589b0f44967c9560b432ec25b5ae4',
 'N1-B126-CLAUDE-001-phase2-message.txt': '568b1ea8dbc52676eef8ea838d298031aaf42fcf144b6aff6b14d7df112c5aad',
 'N1-B126-CLAUDE-001-extension.json': '722be47b02b8d484cc2bd2b80de68ad3d01d8441c6a463393b929035d0068e3a',
 'guarded-test-v2.py': 'b078c17c280978c185f53b85698d916279700bf766a08aea03473efa357689dc',
}
verified = {}
for relative, digest in expected.items():
 path = review.joinpath(*relative.split('/'))
 actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert actual == digest, (str(path), actual, digest)
 verified[str(path)] = actual
phase = json.loads((review / 'N1-B126-CLAUDE-001-phase1.json').read_text('utf-8'))
assert phase['status'] == 'PHASE1_READY' and phase['readyForPhase2'] and not phase['breaches']
for filename, key in [('audit.json', 'auditSha256'), ('events.jsonl', 'eventsSha256'), ('phase1-list.txt', 'phase1ListSha256')]:
 path = Path(phase['auditDir']) / filename
 actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert actual == phase[key], (str(path), actual)
 verified[str(path)] = actual
repo = root / 'b126-worktree'
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-pager', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True, timeout=30).strip()
assert head == '246a1319ef30414d73e4518b52ae99c1d700c57e', head
status = subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-pager', '-C', str(repo), 'status', '--porcelain=v1'], text=True, timeout=30)
assert not status.strip(), status
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','candidate':head,'worktreeClean':True,'verifiedArtifactHashes':verified,'limit':'Recovery identity check only; final review audit, substantive adjudication and publication still pending.'}, indent=2))
